title: Cards Against Hackatoa — Free Party Card Game Online
description: Cards Against Hackatoa is a free Cards Against Humanity-style party game. No czar — everyone votes each round. Custom cards, wild cards, image uploads, and a community card library. No sign-up required.
ogTitle: Cards Against Hackatoa — Free Party Card Game
intro: A black card shows a fill-in-the-blank prompt. Everyone picks white card(s) from their hand to complete it. Then everyone votes for the funniest answer — no czar. Most votes wins the round. First to the score goal wins.
